news.snippet: Valuation figures come from outside the company blog and should be read accordin...
news.raw_snippet:
Valuation figures come from outside the company blog and should be read accordingly. Reflection's own news page links a CNBC segment dated April 23, 2026, in which the CEO confirms a round closed at a $25 billion pre-money valuation.

## The Compute Deals Behind the Model

Reflection has signed unusually large compute agreements for a company with no released model. Its own news page links the coverage of each one. [...] Reflection AI confirmed on its own blog that it raised $2 billion to build frontier open intelligence. That announcement is the strongest primary source on the round.

The company names its investors directly: B Capital, Citi, CRV, Disruptive, DST, Eric Schmidt, Zoom Ventures, Nvidia, Sequoia, 1789, "and others." Nvidia is the investor most often attached to the company in press coverage. [...] ## What Should a Business Buyer Do About Reflection AI Today?

Nothing yet. There is no model to evaluate, no license to review, and no price to plan against, so there is no decision available to make.
